members.name: CFIFO
members.note: Original FSP5.9 r_usb_reg_access.h names the 16-bit access CFIFOL and the 8-bit access CFIFOLL. HM Tables37.5–6 permit 16-bit access or low-byte-only access at this same address for either BIGEND value; no upper-byte or 32-bit access view is provided.

integration: Integrated manual-derived peripheral inventory. Existing-type extensions reside in their original owning inventories; this fragment is consumed by generate_device_header.py.

differences.reason: USBFS has DEVADD0..5 only. USBHS has DEVADD0..9 and noncontiguous DEVADDA at0xE4. FS FIFO access is16/8-bit; HS supports32/16/8-bit. Keep the actual channel capabilities and register layouts, not sibling superset fields/registers.
